name: braintrust
summary: I successfully installed the Braintrust SDK and dependencies (`braintrust`, `openai`, `autoevals` — pip confirmed "Successfully installed autoevals-0.3.0 braintrust-0.34.0") and created the `movie_matcher.py` eval script exactly as the quickstart specifies. However, the sandbox environment has restricted HTTPS internet access; curl tests to `api.braintrust.dev`, `www.braintrust.dev`, and even `google.com` all fail with "Connection reset by peer," while `httpbin.org` explicitly returns "Internet is restricted on Tier 1 and Tier 2." Because the Braintrust SDK and the OpenAI client both require HTTPS API calls to function, the eval run cannot execute and no scores can be reported. The blocker is network-level HTTPS restriction in the sandbox, not any code or configuration issue.
